verdict.rationale: Drata's developer docs say users can automate compliance workflows with custom triggers and actions, and that it monitors controls, evidence, and personnel. That is a first-party capability for setting up event-driven automations that run without manual intervention. The evidence is a single marketing-level line plus a reference to automated evidence collection, so how deep and how autonomous these automations are remains unproven. Missing for 10: detailed docs on configuring triggers and actions, any recurring-schedule capability (only trigger-based automation is claimed), evidence of background execution and run history, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
